record.label: Kappa3-squared emission terms
record.summary: Second-order pattern-pair emission (GH-validated scalar framework). PLANE half: deep planes -3.5% rel AND the chain conversion improves (the one supply fix that converted at n=2) - shipped as SECOND_ORDER=1. DISTINCT half: helps at w256, slightly negative at w1024 (fresh kappa3^2 scales ~1/width) - OFF at the target width.
record.terminal_criterion: Terminal: both halves measured at both widths.

evidence.finding: KAPPA3-SQUARED WIRING, STEP 1 (plane class): added the second-order pattern-pair response to emission_K21 (pairs of D(3,0)/D(0,3)/P(2,1)/P(1,2) insertions, kappa-weighted k3 and carried K21, reusing the Mehler series with counts to (6,0); scalar framework = second_order_triple.py w256, validated there by 3D Gauss-Hermite; env SECOND_ORDER=1; assembly is exact product-rule since r1/r2 already carry their GC second order). RESULT r35: deep planes improve with the mode's own depth profile - L12 0.0802->0.0777, L13 0.0855->0.0826, L14 0.0935->0.0901 (~3.5% relative) - but the k3^2/v-mode COEFFICIENT moves only -0.2255 -> -0.2177: the plane-class emission carries ~1/6 of the kappa3-squared content. THE MAJORITY is emitted into the DISTINCT tensor via the completion's missing three-node second-order pattern-pairs (55 pairs, connected filter) and reaches the pre planes through the push. That wiring (on-device, ~3-5x completion cost) is the named next implementation - diagnosis now carries three independent confirmations: row-weight k3^2/v 0.92-0.94 cross-net, the depth-profile match, and the plane-class fix moving exactly its predicted minority share.

KAPPA3^2 STEP 2 (distinct-tensor pattern pairs, exact coefficients, broadcast form crosschecked to 1e-12 against the GH-validated scalar reference): WIDTH-DEPENDENT VERDICT. w256 gate: deep tensor IMPROVES (K21_rel l31 0.500->0.474, l24 0.456->0.433; shallow slightly worse at rho_absmax 0.75 = bond_cap-3 truncation; free-run FINAL 2.41e-5->2.50e-5 = the known co-adaptation pattern of that frame). w1024 (validation frame, honest carry): the distinct half is slightly NEGATIVE - L12 0.0777 (plane-half only) -> 0.0791, mode coef -0.2177 -> -0.2209 - consistent with kappa3^2 fresh emission scaling ~1/width (4x smaller relative at 1024). CONCLUSION: the w1024 deep k3^2/v-row deficit is NOT primarily fresh-emission kappa3^2; candidate carriers sharing that row direction: F3 transport error of carried distinct content (weights concentrate on the most non-Gaussian rows), or higher-bond emission truncation. Validated w1024 config = SECOND_ORDER=1 (plane half) only: deep planes 0.0802->0.0777/0.0935->0.0901. Final honest chain on that supply queued.

NIGHT CLOSE (07:15): the derived kappa3^2 PLANE-half supply CONVERTS through the honest chain - held-out beta transfer 14.5%/11.7% both directions = 2.347e-8/2.362e-8 (vs plain honest 13.6/10.7 = 2.374/2.390e-8). Unlike the empirical k4xm profile (which improved plane RMS but washed in the chain), the derived term carries consistent injections - the distinction the carrier-plane-rms-is-not-the-objective law predicted. FINAL NIGHT LADDER (r35, honest, held-out weights): deployed 2.676e-8 -> tonight's best estimated 2.362e-8 (-11.7%) -> true-supply ceiling 1.21e-8 -> oracle-delta ceiling 7.09e-9. Every rung measured; the supply gap 2.36e-8 -> 1.21e-8 is the daytime battlefield: (a) w1024 deep deficit carrier (transport-error/truncation class, k3^2/v row signature), (b) 10-net LOO to certify weights, (c) deploy-frame gate, (d) hub CP compression for submission-time supply.

record.goal_path_summary: A missing mathematical term (the square of the skewness) in how each layer emits statistics. We derived it exactly, checked it against brute-force integration, and shipped the half that works at competition size - it made both the statistics AND the final answer better, the only fix of the campaign that did both. The other half only matters for smaller networks and is switched off. This node is finished; it contributed a permanent point of score improvement.
